title: cargo fmt --all --check fails on main, masking every later CI step
description:
CI's first step is 'cargo fmt --all --check' and it exits 1 on main.

  persona-attestors/src/did_key.rs:101 — a test call is wrapped across three
  lines where rustfmt wants one.

Impact is larger than the formatting itself: fmt is the first step of the Check
job, so the job stops there and clippy, build and test never run in CI at all.
persona-5s4b.27 reports the clippy gate failing, which is true locally, but CI
has never actually reached clippy — the run dies one step earlier.

Confirmed in GitHub Actions run 34791700961: Check (ubuntu-latest) fails at the
fmt step, exit 1.

Missed by the original review: two agents verified 'cargo clippy' and neither ran
'cargo fmt --check', so the earliest gate went unexamined. Worth remembering that
verifying step N says nothing about steps 1..N-1.

Fix is 'cargo fmt --all'. Deliberately not applied here — out of scope for the
audit work that surfaced it.
close_reason: Fixed and verified. See commit 7c013e3. .3 closed separately: x509-cert bumped to 0.3.0; deletion recommendation retained in its notes.
